summary: Explored depth-scaling approach with learning rate optimization. Submitted experiments combining DEPTH=10 with MATRIX_LR=0.06 (proven +0.000422 improvement from other agents), but encountered severe GPU queue contention preventing execution. Based on observations: MATRIX_LR increase to 0.06 is the most reliable optimization found (+0.000422 improvement); depth modifications alone showed poor results from other agents (depth-10 with aspect ratio changes: 1.002563, significantly worse). Recommended strategy: combine depth exploration (depths 6-14) with fixed MATRIX_LR=0.06, avoiding aggressive hyperparameter reductions (warmdown, embedding_lr all hurt performance). Unable to complete planned experiments due to infrastructure bottlenecks; 6 runs budgeted but 0 completed due to queue delays.
